categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: 'Medical Services + Internet Medical Services' and 'Telecommunications and Value-added Telecom Services'. The medical segment includes offline hospital services, internet hospital platforms, medical information services, medical e-commerce, smart health monitoring devices, and medical AI products. The telecom segment focuses on mobile communication resale and IPTV value-added services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages internet technologies, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), 5G, blockchain, and cloud computing to empower medical services and telecom operations. It develops AI-driven medical consultation systems, real-time audio-video processing, distributed modular online clinic systems, and blockchain-based channel fund management. The company also manufactures medical devices like blood glucose meters using proprietary medical modules.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual patients, grassroots hospitals, provincial and municipal medical insurance centers, telecom users, and telecom operators. The medical services target patients nationwide, especially in grassroots and county-level hospitals, while telecom services cater to personal, group, and industry clients across China. Major customers include social insurance centers and large internet companies like Baidu.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with business coverage nationwide including over 20 provinces for IPTV services and extensive presence in Guizhou province for medical and pharmaceutical services. It has subsidiaries and offices in cities like Guiyang, Guangzhou, Beijing, and Tianjin. International cooperation exists with partners in countries along the Belt and Road, such as Turkey and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly midstream and downstream in the supply chain. It provides end-user medical services and internet medical platforms, manufactures medical devices, and resells telecom services to end customers. It also engages in pharmaceutical distribution, acting as a wholesaler and retailer within the medical supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening integration of internet and medical services, advancing medical AI research and product development, and expanding telecom resale and IPTV services. R&D focuses on AI-powered medical consultation, 5G-based medical gateways, cloud-based communication management, blockchain for fund and data security, and smart health monitoring devices. The company emphasizes innovation in AI to enhance healthcare accessibility and efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through medical service fees, internet medical platform subscriptions and consultations, pharmaceutical sales, telecom service fees from mobile communication resale, and value-added telecom service subscriptions and advertising. The company also earns income from technology licensing, advertising on medical information platforms, and sales of smart health devices.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading integrated internet medical and telecom service provider in Guizhou province and among China's top 100 software and IT service enterprises. It is the only internet medical company ranked in the top 100 Chinese internet enterprises. Competitors include other internet medical platforms, telecom operators, and medical service providers, with increasing competition in internet healthcare and telecom resale markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 459.6 million, a 5.26% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 77.45 million, up 10.19%. Total assets reached about RMB 1.88 billion, with steady growth in medical services and telecom resale revenues. R&D investment increased by 18.62% to RMB 33.88 million, reflecting a growth-oriented profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique integration of offline medical institutions with online internet medical platforms, leveraging AI and big data to provide personalized, accessible, and high-quality healthcare services. Its proprietary AI medical consultation system '39AI General Practitioner' is a key differentiator. The combination of telecom services with medical platforms and smart health devices creates a comprehensive healthcare ecosystem, enhancing user experience and resource accessibility.
